finding: A single unhalted observation after thaw does not guarantee that the moving sealed/posted lag remains below the deliberately small budget until the probe submits. The one-shot transfer fails immediately on a renewed refusal of the injected cause.
change: The DA recovery transfer retries only the exact typed da_lag-at-sealer refusal, using one signed transaction and the existing 60-second outer deadline covering nonce lookup, submits and receipt. Other faults explicitly select NoQuorum and retain their existing retry policy.
preserved: Proof that the batcher posts past the frozen head
Receipt success and exact submitted hash
One nonce lookup and identical bytes across refused attempts
Immediate failure for another root, cause or RPC error
Failure for a persistent halt, wrong hash, missing receipt or unsuccessful receipt
Every existing fault, rate, case, shard and recovery deadline

negative_controls: Disabling the DA retry reproduces immediate failure on the observed refusal.
Retrying every halted-chain error violates the immediate rejection control for an unrelated no-quorum cause.

impact: Chaos probe only; no product runtime, admission policy, service wiring or hot path changes.
limitations: Live DA recovery must still pass fresh CI.
This does not establish a solution to runner contention or performance regression.
